# ColorGreen

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Drawing](BlitzBasic-Drawing)

## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
ColorGreen:Int32
```

## Description

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

_Not documented yet._

## Parameters

**Returns:** The green part, 0 to 255, of the current drawing color.
